notes: The Avenger is currently Jeep Australia's only BEV; it is sold exclusively as a front-drive EV locally (overseas petrol/mild-hybrid/4xe Avenger variants are not sold in Australia). WLTP range is quoted by the official jeep.com.au site as 'up to 390km'; a Stellantis press release separately cited 391-396km depending on trim, a minor discrepancy resolved in favour of the official AU site figure. Pricing has fluctuated heavily via promotions (as low as $40,000 drive-away in early 2026 vs an original before-on-road-costs launch price of $53,990); the $49,990/$54,990 before-on-road-costs figures used here are the most recent 'before on-road costs' figures reported by CarExpert (March 2026). Summit trim price could not be reconfirmed for 2026 (last known figure was $60,990 from September 2024) and is left null rather than guessed. IMPORTANT WITHDRAWAL: per EV Central (6 July 2026), Jeep has cancelled right-hand-drive production of both the Wagoneer S (flagship electric SUV, previously slated for Australian launch in 2026) and the Recon for markets including Australia and the UK, citing RHD development cost and market conditions; Jeep is instead pursuing a joint venture with Dongfeng for a future RHD-market SUV, targeted no earlier than late 2027. Neither Wagoneer S nor Recon is listed in variants as a result.
